paper_id: Don't Fish in Troubled Waters! Characterizing Coronavirus-themed Cryptocurrency Scams
title: Don't Fish in Troubled Waters! Characterizing Coronavirus-themed Cryptocurrency Scams
motivation: COVID-19 pandemic引发加密货币诈骗激增, FBI警告此类骗局增加, 受害者已损失超7700万美元
problem_framing: 首次系统性测量研究COVID-19主题加密货币诈骗的6种类型、流行程度和社会工程技巧
key_insight: 利用疫情特定信任(WHO/CDC)和公众健康焦虑,通过混合方法发现195个已知和未知诈骗案例
method_signature: 混合方法: 从报告数据库收集已知诈骗+基于关键词/域名/恶意软件检测未知诈骗, 手动验证
evaluation_criteria: 收集195个诈骗案例、201个区块链地址、估算33万美元损失、6329名受害者
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: taxonomy可能不完整; 手动识别方法不可扩展; 仅为下界估计
evidence_for_taste: the taxonomy is summarized based on public known scams
we only consider the transactions related to these scam addresses since the beginning of the pandemic
our estimation is definitely a lower bound
one scam address can be used to fulfill more than one type of scam activities
this work relies on some manually efforts to identify the unrevealed scams
thinking_moves: 先构建6类诈骗taxonomy, 再用混合方法系统收集已知和未知诈骗
跨平台数据源整合(BitcoinAbuse, CryptoScamDB, BitcoinTalk, Twitter, Telegram)
从公开安全报告和用户举报中提炼诈骗模式和社会工程技巧
通过区块链交易追溯量化诈骗财务影响(下界估计)
